movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

movelist.name: Endeavor
movelist.effect: The target loses a Tick of Hit Points for each Injury the user has.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Cruelty
abilities.effect: After Damage is Resolved, the foe gains an Injury. The user is then informed of the total number of Injuries currently on the target, and may use that number to “purchase” the effects listed below. »» 1 Injury: The target loses 2 Hit Points. May be “pur- chased” multiple times. »» 1 Injury: The target is Slowed. »» 2 Injuries: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.
